about: Pass 7 (2026-10-09), batch C: comparator cells for 26 openly licensed LLM sources whose 167 recorded results sat alone in their run (lone-batch-C.json). Candidate rows only; data/ was not edited. 461 results (212 lab, 249 independent) + 1 proposed comparison-only model (phi-4-reasoning-plus); no new ledger entries or benchmarks (every row reuses the source URL and source_id of the existing row for that document; ledger scope notes are in the .md). Only cells printed as text were used; comparator cells were taken only where the document says the authors ran them (or marks own-run cells), or where the column is the authors' own model family. Merge: models first, then results via npm run import. Simulated on a scratch copy (import +1 model, +461 results, no skips; scripts/check.ts --validate-only passes). Engine run check (key bench@sourceId(url)): of the 167 listed lone runs, 10 already counted before (Falcon-H1R: comparator rows lacked source_id), 113 now count, 44 stay lone (chart-image-only cards: Ling-3.0-flash 15, DeepSeek-V3.2 7, MiMo-V2.5-Pro 7, GLM-5.3-Flash 2, DeepSeek-V3-0324 1; copied-only comparators: DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B 5; quantised-only comparators: SqueezeBits EXAONE 3; '-' cells: DeepSeek-R1-0528 BFCL/Tau 3; Qwen3.8 stray livecodebench-v6 duplicate 1). 138 runs newly count in total (including new runs such as omni-math, mcp-atlas, tau2-telecom).
